scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-zaka --only firestore,storage "npm run test:rules"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-zaka --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "vitest run test/integration --testTimeout=30000 --hookTimeout=30000"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-zaka --only auth,firestore,storage,functions
